newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-AMMACCAPANE ENDS TITLE DROUGHT WITH LPGA WIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-AMMACCAPANE ENDS TITLE DROUGHT WITH LPGA WIN.

text.p: Danielle Ammaccapane ended a five-year title drought Sunday by firing a 4-under-par 68 for a one-shot triumph at the Edina Realty LPGA Classic at the Rush Creek Golf Club.
Ammaccapane made up a five-stroke deficit to claim her fifth career victory after 1993 champion Hiromi Kobayashi of Japan and overnight leader Brandie Burton faltered down the stretch.
Ammaccapane, 31, finished with a 54-hole total of 8-under 208 to earn $90,000. The winner's prize exceeded her LPGA Tour earnings for the last two years combined.

"It crossed my mind to quit once," she confessed. "I didn't think I could win again out here. I wasn't having any fun. I can't believe I'm sitting here talking to you guys," she told reporters at the victory interview session.
Kobayashi, Mayumi Hirase, Catriona Matthew and Jane Geddes finished tied for second at 209.
Burton, who followed her second-round 68 by stumbling to a three-over 75 Sunday, finished another stroke back at 210, along with Kris Tschetter.
